integrity: Analytic proof and reproducible exact-rational/numerical consistency checks; independent validation has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Two-mode real positive-definite quadratic, matched BB1 first step, exact arithmetic, fixed nonbalanced starting gradient. No claim for more than two distinct Hessian eigenvalues or BB2; priority of an equivalent full-norm formula in inaccessible early literature is not conclusively excluded.
title: A universal log-periodic gradient envelope for two-mode Barzilai–Borwein descent
